title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN MIDDAY BRIEF**

BTC holding at $75,898 despite a 2.1% pullback—but here's what matters: miners haven't stopped accumulating since February. That's structural pressure building underneath.

Hashrate just hit 960 EH/s. Network's ironclad. Meanwhile, market dominance sits at 57.28%—Bitcoin's stranglehold on crypto intensifies as alternatives bleed out.

Fear & Greed at 26. Pure fear territory. Yet the mempool's clean—one sat/vB for fastest fees. That's efficiency in a tight market.
